note: 🏷️ One language-agnostic contract for the LocalizedLabel wire, read by BOTH implementations: the Rust decoder (🌐️locale/🧪️tests/🏷️localized-label-fixture) and the AJV schema oracle plus historyEntryLabelText (🎠️kernel/🧪️tests/🏷️localized-label-fixture). Nothing here names a language in code: every expectation is keyed '<terminology>.<locale>' from 🖱️ui/🎚️axes/🔣️.json, so adding an axis adds keys and fails both readers until every row is translated.

rows.why: 🧱️ A framework history row: authored copy, a real translation per cell, both terminologies distinct.
🏷️ A label whose runtime data (the layer name) is quoted inside authored copy — the quoted datum is identical in every cell, the prose around it is not.

📊️ LocalizedLabel::data — a shell-noted command id or a fixture name. Locale-INVARIANT by construction, so every cell is byte-identical; this row exists so 'identical cells' is a declared, tested shape and not read as an untranslated leak.

refusals.why: 🚫️ A carrier that filled only one locale. The schema REFUSES the document (the locale key is required), and the readers resolve the absent cell to the EMPTY string — visibly wrong — instead of falling back to another locale's text.
🚫️ The pre-LocalizedLabel shape ({en, de} with no terminology level) that took the whole shell down on 2026-09-21. Refused by the schema; resolved as empty, never thrown.
🚫️ A cell for a locale the axes do not declare. Refused by the schema rather than silently carried through the wire into a panel that can never render it.
